e-email-digest.1.evidence: Settings > Email Digest: Default Frequency Weekly saved ('Digest settings saved.'), option jetonomy_pro_digest_settings default_frequency weekly with from_name/from_email blank; digests arrive From 'Northwind Makers Community <admin@example.test>', the Settings > Emails sender.

e-email-digest.2.evidence: POST /admin/digest/test frequency daily as admin -> 200 success true 'Test digest sent to admin@example.test.'; message in Mailpit within seconds.

e-email-digest.3.evidence: digest bodies: 'Community Digest: November 10, 2026', intro line with counts, Trending, New in Spaces You Follow, Top Topics, Replies sections only when they have content; no '&' in titles, no images, text/plain part has no HTML tags.

e-email-digest.4.evidence: PATCH /users/me/digest-preferences none/daily/weekly -> 200 each and GET returns it; 'monthly' -> 400 rest_invalid_param 'Invalid parameter(s): frequency'.

e-email-digest.5.evidence: do_action jetonomy_pro_send_daily_digest + Action Scheduler run for bob (daily): one 'Your Daily Community Digest' email; the same run again sent nothing. (wp cron event run fails: the digest cron events are not scheduled in this stack, so the hook was fired with wp eval.)

e-email-digest.6.evidence: weekly run immediately after a send (no new activity) -> no digest email to anyone (not an empty shell).

e-email-digest.7.evidence: test_subscriber's weekly digest contains no topic from Customer Advisory Board, Moderators' Room, Insiders / Beta; alice (Partner Program member) digest includes the Partner Program item.

e-email-digest.8.evidence: digest footer link ?jetonomy_digest_unsub=1&uid=10&token=... logged out -> 'You have been unsubscribed from community digest emails. You can re-enable them anytime from your profile settings.'; frequency none; following weekly and daily runs sent bob nothing.

e-email-digest.9.evidence: wrong token -> 403 'Invalid or expired unsubscribe link.'; no token -> 400 'Invalid unsubscribe link.'; (frequency was not changed by either: it changed only after the valid link).

e-email-digest.10.evidence: walknone with jetonomy_email_opt_out=1 (Pause all email) got no weekly digest while 29 other recipients did.

e-email-digest.11.evidence: finn (silenced) received the weekly digest; his own earlier posts are not listed.

e-email-digest.12.evidence: alice blocked omar (POST /users/me/blocks): omar's new Help Desk topic is absent from alice's 'New in Spaces You Follow', maya's topic is there.

e-email-digest.13.evidence: ENV: 3,000-subscriber scale and a transient SMTP failure cannot be reproduced here. Observed instead: the weekly run is dispatched as a jetonomy_pro_digest_batch Action Scheduler job (batch of 50) and each of 30 recipients got exactly one email.

e-email-digest.14.evidence: admin GET /admin/digest/stats -> 200 {daily,weekly,none,no_preference,total}; bob GET stats and POST /admin/digest/test -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden.

e-email-digest.15.evidence: digest with maya's Arabic topic and a 150-character title: Arabic links carry dir=auto (computed rtl), long title present; rendered at 390px the mail has no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 390); explicit light backgrounds #f4f4f7/#ffffff and fixed text colours.

e-email-digest.16.evidence: email-digest extension turned off: the old unsubscribe URL answers a clear 'Invalid or expired unsubscribe link.' page (403), no fatal or 404; extension restored.

e-email-digest.17.evidence: paid-memberships-pro active: the text/plain part of the admin test digest and of alice's digest contains no HTML tags or entities; plugin deactivated afterwards.

e-email-digest.18.evidence: alice's 'New in Spaces You Follow' lists maya's topic and leaves out alice's own new topic (her own topic only appears in the site-wide Trending / Top Topics sections).
